# yc-companies

Intro paragraph.

## Selection contract

<!-- Read by packages/research-enrich to judge whether a document belongs in this topic. English on purpose. -->

- **Purpose:** Keep a local mirror of the public YC company directory so an idea can be checked for who already occupies the space, in which batch, and with what status.
- **Core:** One directory note per company from the yc-oss dataset for the synced batches (Winter 2024 through Winter 2027): one-liner, long description, batch, status, industries, tags, and the application answers stored on that note.
- **Adjacent (keep):** none. Idea cross-checks that consume this directory live in other folders; this topic is the directory itself.
- **Collected on purpose:** The full multi-industry directory, including companies unrelated to any current idea, and on-demand founder or launch pages for a company that hits a cross-check (none ingested yet).
- **Out of scope:** Postmortems and news that explain why a company died or was acquired; admissions essays and interview how-tos that are not the application answers on a company note; third-party profiles that are neither a directory record nor a reserved founder or launch page; essays that only mention YC and are not a company note.
